# US-004: Download a file

## User Story

As a Client, I want to download a shared file, so that I can use it outside the portal.

## Context

Quote P1 #2 "tải về"; no control drawn.

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — File downloaded

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-project-files-011
- **Screen:** project-files

```gherkin
Given a member sees "711_Approved Proposal.docx"
When they download it
Then a file named "711_Approved Proposal.docx" is saved
And its size and content are identical to the uploaded file
```

Placement of the Download control: TBD (spec OQ-6).

### AC-002 — Download refused for non-members

- **Type:** permission
- **Covers:** FR-project-files-011, FR-project-files-013
- **Error code:** E-auth-access-003

```gherkin
Given client A is not a member of "Grab Transport"
When client A opens the download link of a "Grab Transport" file
Then no file is returned and E-auth-access-003 is shown (wording TBD)
```

### AC-003 — Download fails

- **Type:** error-path · **blocked by spec OQ-15** (no error code or wording yet)
- **Covers:** FR-project-files-011

```gherkin
Given a member downloads a file while the storage service is unavailable
When the download is attempted
Then {result decided in OQ-15}
```
